name: Ranger Bryony

intro.text: I look after the cliffs. My job is to stand around in a hi-vis jacket and tell people to keep back from the edge. I'm very, very good at it. Now keep back. Battle?

win: A fair win. Mind the edge on the way off.
after: A puffin's beak is at its brightest in the breeding season, and it sheds the colourful plates in winter. It can hold a dozen sandeels at once, lined up crosswise, and it flies at 80 kilometres an hour with its wings a blur.
